name: Bento cell footer
description: A grid of filled cells directly under the last scene, 64px side padding, 12px gaps, radius 20px, about 520px tall at 1440. No borders. The cells sit on a 12-column grid across the 1312px content width. Row one: a logo cell over 4 columns (brand mark at 64px, one 18px sentence), a link-list cell over 3 columns (six links at 20px on a 44px step) and a newsletter cell over 5 columns (in the accent colour with ink text; a 28px heading and a joined field and button). Row two: two social tiles over 2 and 3 columns (each holds one 24px link word, no icon above it) and a legal cell over 7 columns (copyright and two links at 14px). Cells use three tones of the page palette, never more, and none is nested in another. Hover steps a cell one tone lighter and shifts its link 6px right. On enter the cells fade-rise with a 60ms stagger from the top left. Use only where the section above is not itself a card grid. Phone: Cells stack in one column at 8px gaps, newsletter first; widths become full.
phone: Cells stack in one column at 8px gaps, newsletter first; widths become full.
avoidWith: a card grid section directly above
a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Outlined cells and hairlines would break the outline and rule bans: the cells are filled in different tones with no outlines, rules or nesting. Cards with a fill are wanted; keep it off pages whose section above is a card grid, so the page is not only boxes.

name: Big link list over shader band
description: Dark footer of about 1.3 screens (1150px at 1440) that rises into place: its content moves from 120px below to its resting place, tied to scroll, while the footer top travels from the bottom of the viewport to the top. 64px side padding, 120px top padding. Left column (700px): six or seven navigation links set at 52-56px bold in the display face, 20px apart and with no rules between them. Hover shifts the hovered link 16px to the right and tints it with the accent while the others dim to 50%. Middle column (x 880, 300px wide): a filled status pill at 16px in sentence case (one short line, such as open for new work), the contact line at 24px, the address at 18px. Right column (x 1240): three secondary links at 18px. 96px lower a row with a live local clock at the left, a back-to-top text link in the centre and copyright at the right, 14px. At the end a band 320px tall, inset 24px from the sides with radius 24px, holds a shader field in two flat palette tones whose boundary is warped slowly by noise (hard-edged, no colour ramps) and one short closing line at 40px in the centre. Phone: Links 36px in one column, contact blocks below, band 220px with the line at 28px.
phone: Links 36px in one column, contact blocks below, band 220px with the line at 28px.
houseRuleCheck: Rules under each big link and a quote in the band would break the hairline and text bans: spacing replaces the rules and the band carries one short line. The shader uses two flat tones with a warped edge, so it is not a gradient.

name: Identity left, info stack right
description: Split footer about one screen tall (840px at 1440) on a solid ground, 64px side padding, 120px vertical padding. The left third (440px wide) holds the identity block: the brand mark at 72-96px high and under it a two-line statement at 40px in the display face. The right two thirds start at x 520 and stack three blocks on a 64px step: contact (the email as a plain 28px link, the phone at 18px), address and hours at 18px, then link groups at 18px on a 220px pitch. Social and legal links sit at the foot on one 16px line, spread left and right. Colour roles: dark ground with off-white ink, or pale ground with near-black ink; the accent colours only hover and the contact link underline. On enter the right stack rises 24px and fades in, blocks 80ms apart. Phone: Identity block first, then the stack as one column with 40px gaps; social and legal links stack.
phone: Identity block first, then the stack as one column with 40px gaps; social and legal links stack.
houseRuleCheck: A large wordmark in the left third would be the banned giant footer name, and rules between the right-hand blocks are hairlines. Here the left holds a small mark and a statement and the blocks are separated by space; the email stays at 28px. The split itself is kept.

name: Centred call over directory band
description: Dark footer of one screen (100vh) uncovered from under the page: the footer sits fixed behind the end of the main content, which carries a bottom margin equal to the footer height, so the last section slides up off it like a lifted sheet. Upper half: a centred two-line headline at 70px in the display face, off-white ink, and 24px beneath it one filled button with a trailing arrow (accent colour, 56px tall, fully rounded). From about 0.62 of the height runs a band: at the left the logo lockup (40px high) and a filled 16px status pill in sentence case, in the centre three link columns on a 200px pitch (18px titles, 16px links), at the right a row of social text links; 64px lower a split copyright row at 14px. Headline lines fade-rise on enter, 80ms apart; hover moves the button arrow 6px. Phone: Headline 40px, button full width, link columns 2-up, band stacks; the stacked footer is taller than the screen, so the reveal is dropped and it scrolls in normally.
phone: Headline 40px, button full width, link columns 2-up, band stacks; the stacked footer is taller than the screen, so the reveal is dropped and it scrolls in normally.
houseRuleCheck: The headline is one plain style with no accent word, and the status pill is filled and in sentence case. A fixed reveal only works when the footer fits the viewport, hence one screen on desktop and none on the phone. No conflict.

name: Emblem reveal with side links
description: A closing screen (100vh) on a flat deep ground. A centred emblem about 560px wide (the brand symbol or one rendered object on a transparent background, never a wordmark) fades in from a 12px blur at 1.2x scale to 1x over 1.4s as the screen enters. Then a link row fades in along the bottom: action links at the left, text links with the legal line at the right, 24px side padding, 40px bottom padding, 18px text, 32px gaps. A column of three to five social text links sits near the right edge at mid-height with a 24px margin, 16px, stacked top to bottom. Off-white ink on the flat ground; the accent colours the hovered link only. Phone: Emblem at 70% of the width; the link row wraps into two rows and the social links join the bottom row.
phone: Emblem at 70% of the width; the link row wraps into two rows and the social links join the bottom row.
houseRuleCheck: A soft radial halo would be a gradient and a rail of social icons breaks the icon ban: the ground is flat and the social links are text in a side column. The emblem is a symbol or an object, never a wordmark.

name: Headline over photo row
description: Light grey ground, one screen (900px at 1440), 200px top padding. A centred two-line headline at 54px, and 24px under it one text link with an accent underline. 96px lower, a row of five photos stays inside the 64px side margins: squares of 200px and 240px alternating, 32px gaps, radius 20px, offset vertically 0 and 40px in a gentle wave. 64px under the row, two small filled pills (the social links as words) sit centred. On scroll the photos drift horizontally in alternation (even ones 40px left, odd ones 40px right, tied to scroll); hover scales one photo to 1.06. The row is centred, so the alternating drift never crosses the 64px margins. A 14px legal line sits 48px from the bottom. Ink near-black, accent only on the link underline. Phone: Photos in a 2-up staggered grid of four; the pills stack.
phone: Photos in a 2-up staggered grid of four; the pills stack.
houseRuleCheck: A photo row cut by both screen edges breaks the frame rule: here the row stays inside the margins. Photos must be art-directed, never archive or documentary shots.

name: Picture with scattered contacts
description: Dark ground, about 1.5 screens (1350px at 1440). A centred picture 440px wide starts at y 160: a treated high-contrast image or one rendered object, toned to a single ink (never a drawn illustration). Contact items are scattered around it in a loose, asymmetric ring with 80-200px gaps: the email at the upper left (28px), the phone at the lower right (28px), the city and hours as two 18px lines, three social links at 18px, each its own small block in sentence case. No connecting lines. A 14px legal line sits at the bottom left. On scroll the picture drifts up slower than the page (parallax 0.85) and each item fades in sliding 40px toward its place, 100ms apart. Hover tints an item with the accent. Off-white ink on the dark ground. Phone: Picture at 70% width; items stack in one centred column, 24px apart: email, phone, city, social.
phone: Picture at 70% width; items stack in one centred column, 24px apart: email, phone, city, social.
houseRuleCheck: Small uppercase labels and a drawn halftone illustration would break two bans: the items are sentence case at 18-28px and the picture is a raster or a render, never a drawing or a documentary photograph.

name: Centred logo and link row over columns
description: A coloured panel inset 16px from the viewport edges, radius 28px, about 760px tall, solid brand colour as ground, 120px top padding. A centred logo lockup 56px high; 56px below it a centred row of seven primary links set bold at 22px on a 160px pitch, hover underlining in the ink. 96px under that, three left-aligned link columns on a 300px pitch starting at x 160 (18px titles, 16px links), and at the far right a round back-to-top button (a 56px filled disc in a darker tone). The last row sits 80px below with the legal line at the left and social text links at the right. Ink is off-white or near-black, chosen for contrast with the brand colour. For a quieter page the panel can instead be a soft tint of the accent close to the page ground, with only its top corners rounded at 50px, rising 60px into view top first. Phone: Lockup and primary links in a 2-up grid; columns stack; the panel is inset 8px.
phone: Lockup and primary links in a 2-up grid; columns stack; the panel is inset 8px.
houseRuleCheck: A rule and a row of membership marks would break the hairline and logo-wall bans; both are left out. The inset panel is one card, not boxes in boxes, and its fill is solid in both variants.

name: Statement with cycling word
description: White ground, one screen (900px at 1440). 120px from the top a centred statement of three lines at 54px in the display face, near-black ink. One word in the third line cycles through three to five alternatives (a vertical roll, 400ms, every 2.4s) and is set in the same colour, weight and size as the rest. Then about 300px of empty ground as a deliberate pause, never more than a third of a screen. 64px from the bottom a small centred brand mark (28-40px high), under it one centred row of three or four 16px text links (contact and pages), a one-line 14px legal text and one 16px back-to-top text link. Phone: Statement 34px, the empty gap 160px, the same bottom group. Reduced motion: the first alternative stays.
phone: Statement 34px, the empty gap 160px, the same bottom group. Reduced motion: the first alternative stays.
houseRuleCheck: A pull-up handle is a drag device and is left out. The cycling word keeps the headline style, so it is not a styled accent word. The small link row keeps the footer working, and the pause stays under half a screen of nothing.

name: Centred video tile
description: One screen on a flat mid-grey or deep brand tint. A video tile 830x468 (16:9, radius 12px) is centred at y 150 and loops muted at rest. A 72px filled round play button (ink fill, ground-colour glyph) sits at its centre; a click opens the film in a lightbox with sound. 64px above the bottom, on one line: a 14px legal line at the left margin, two 18px text links centred as a pair with a 40px gap, and one archive link at the right margin. Hover scales the tile to 1.02 and the play button by 8%. Phone: Tile fills the width minus 16px gutters; the links stack.
phone: Tile fills the width minus 16px gutters; the links stack.
avoidWith: a video hero directly at the top of the page
houseRuleCheck: A radial grey ground would be a gradient and a thin outlined play ring an outline: the ground is flat and the play button a filled disc. The legal line at the left keeps the bottom row from being empty on the left.

name: Stage with link selector
description: A final full-screen stage (100vh, dark ground): one 3D object (a model, or a turntable render video) stands on a plinth at the centre and turns slowly. Prev and next arrow buttons (56px filled discs in a tint of the ground) sit left and right of centre, 80px from the sides. At the bottom centre, 80px up, a selector of three link labels at 28px: the middle one is active, in full ink on a filled accent pill, the outer two at 40% ink. The arrow buttons, the arrow keys or a swipe step the selector (the wheel keeps scrolling the page); each step swaps the object pose or material with a 600ms turn, and the active label is the page link. The legal line sits in the bottom left corner and social text links in the bottom right, 14px. Phone: Object at 70% height; only the active label shows with arrows beneath; swipe steps.
phone: Object at 70% height; only the active label shows with arrows beneath; swipe steps.
houseRuleCheck: Corner brackets around the active label would be an outline: a filled pill marks it. Needs a real 3D asset or turntable render; if none exists, do not deal it.

name: Half-dial menu
description: A closing section about 0.55 screen (500px at 1440) on solid ground, off-white ink. In the lower centre sits a half-dial 800px wide by 400px high: five page names in the display face at 28px lie on an ellipse (rx 330, ry 200) around a pivot at the bottom centre. The active name is in full ink and the rest at 40%. A small filled accent dot sits on the ellipse beside the active name; there are no hands and no lines. Hover, focus or the arrow keys rotate the dial so the chosen name travels to the top of the arc (500ms ease), a click follows the link. At the far left and far right of the bottom edge sit a legal line and one credit link at 14px. Phone: Names in a vertical list at 36px with the active one in full ink; the arc is dropped.
phone: Names in a vertical list at 36px with the active one in full ink; the arc is dropped.
avoidWith: a radial navigation in the header
houseRuleCheck: Two thin clock hands would be hairline drawn shapes: a small dot marker replaces them. Keep the header navigation plain; the dial lives only here.

name: Closing giant headline
description: The page ends on a closing scene 160-200vh tall on a single flat colour. The main element is one huge centred display headline at 10-14vw (150-200px at 1440), two or three words per line, tight leading (0.92), one style, high contrast ink on ground; it is never the brand name or the hero headline. The headline is sticky at the centre while its lines reveal word by word (clip-rise, 80ms steps) as the scroll runs through the scene. No link columns: the last 120px of the scene carry one working row at 16px, the legal line at the left and two or three contact or page links at the right. Phone: Headline 14-16vw, lines of one word, scene 140vh long; the working row stacks.
phone: Headline 14-16vw, lines of one word, scene 140vh long; the working row stacks.
avoidWith: a final call-to-action section directly above that repeats the line
houseRuleCheck: A giant headline is allowed; a giant brand name or email is not. The working row keeps it a footer that works rather than a page that just stops.

name: Colour sheet, giant headline
description: A full-screen (100vh) saturated colour sheet with 48px top corners that slides up over the previous section; 136px top padding, 64px side padding, near-black or white ink chosen for contrast. Top row: an 18px paragraph (max 360px), a filled button (ink fill, ground-colour text, 56px tall) and two link columns on a 200px pitch (18px). 130px lower, a left-aligned two-line headline at about 10vw (140px) in the display face, with an address block (18px, three lines) and one 24px contact link in a column beside it at the right. The bottom row, spread at 14px: legal line at the left, small brand mark in the centre, social links at the right. Phone: Headline 56px, the top row stacked, address below, bottom row stacked.
phone: Headline 56px, the top row stacked, address below, bottom row stacked.
houseRuleCheck: The email stays at link size (24px), never set giant. One saturated colour only. No conflict.

name: Prompt band over directory card
description: Two stacked surfaces with 64px side padding. First a full-width coloured band 96px tall (the accent colour, radius 24px on top) with a one-line prompt at 28px at the left and a split button at the right: a 56px pill made of a label cell and a round arrow cell in a darker tone. Directly under it a dark card 460px tall: the logo (36px high), four link columns on a 229px pitch (18px titles, 16px links) and a bottom row at 14px with the legal text at the left and a second, quieter split button (ground tint) at the right. Filled surfaces only. Hover slides the arrow cell 6px and darkens the band. Phone: The band stacks prompt over button; the card columns go 2-up.
phone: The band stacks prompt over button; the card columns go 2-up.
houseRuleCheck: Two filled surfaces, no outlines or rules. No conflict.

name: Directory over last frame
description: The footer content sits over the final frame of the page film or render (100vh), which holds still while a solid dark overlay rises from 0 to 70% opacity as the footer enters (an opacity change, not a ramp). At the left, on the 64px margin and bottom-aligned, a one-sentence quote at 28px. At the right a three-line heading at 40px and under it two link columns on a 240px pitch at 18px. Above them, three or four scene names as 18px text links, 32px apart; clicking one jumps back to that scene. A bottom row spread wide at 14px: legal links at the left, copyright at the right. Off-white ink over the dark frame. Phone: Quote and heading stack; the scene links wrap onto one or two lines; links 2-up.
phone: Quote and heading stack; the scene links wrap onto one or two lines; links 2-up.
houseRuleCheck: A progress rail and a rule would break the rail and hairline bans, and image tiles over the frame would be boxes on a picture: the rail and rule are left out and the scenes are named as text links. The overlay is one flat opacity, not a gradient scrim.

name: Directory over phrase marquee
description: A compact directory (about 0.3 screen, 280px at 1440, 64px side padding) over a full-width marquee band. Directory: at the left a 28px call line in the display face with the contact link under it; in the middle two link columns on a 240px pitch at 18px; at the right a signup as a filled pill field joined to its button. 96px lower, the band is 120-140px tall, filled in the accent colour, its ink near-black or off-white, whichever contrasts. In it, a short invitation phrase of two to four words (never the brand name or an email) is set in display type at about 96px, repeated with a 64px gap, and slides left in a continuous loop at 60-90px per second. Hover slows the band to a stop; the whole band is one link to the contact page. The directory sits on the page ground, the band changes ground to the accent. Reduced motion: one still instance of the phrase, centred. Phone: Directory stacks (call line, link columns 2-up, signup full width). The band drops to 72px with the phrase at 56px and a slower loop.
phone: Directory stacks (call line, link columns 2-up, signup full width). The band drops to 72px with the phrase at 56px and a slower loop.
avoidWith: another marquee band directly above the footer
a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Sliding the brand name in giant type would be the banned giant footer name: here the band slides an invitation phrase, and the sliding band, which is the idea, survives. A marquee is not a drag rail; no rules.

name: Directory, colour panel, monogram
description: Black ground, one screen (900px at 1440), 64px padding. Top left: an 18px name line and under it a two-line newsletter heading at 36px with a filled accent button. At the right two link columns (x 900 and 1120, 18px), with a row of social text links at mid-height. The lower half is a pair of blocks: at the left a monogram 330px high (the brand single-letter mark or one rendered object, in the accent tone), and at the bottom right a flat panel 687x439 in the accent colour (radius 28px) with a two-line call to action at 44px in ink and a pill link under it. A 14px legal line sits under the monogram at the bottom left. Hover brightens the panel one tone; the monogram turns slowly to 6 degrees. Phone: Panel first at full width and 360px high, monogram 160px, columns 2-up.
phone: Panel first at full width and 360px high, monogram 160px, columns 2-up.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: A gradient panel breaks the gradient ban: it is one solid accent colour here. The monogram is one letter of the mark or a render, never a drawn illustration and never the full name.

name: Final stage with corner bar
description: The page ends on a full-screen stage (100vh) that is the footer: a 3D scene, a slow ambient field or a looping film that carries no content block and keeps moving slowly (a turntable or a camera drift). Optionally one medium headline at 44px (one style) sits centred at 55% of the height and works as a link to continue or replay; it fades in as the stage enters, an accent underline grows under it on hover, and a click replays the page or moves to the next one with a 600ms wipe. Along the bottom runs a 64px bar with 24px side padding and no panel behind it, text off-white at 16px: the legal line at the left, three to five social or contact text links 24px apart at the right. Keep the lower 120px of the stage dark (the scene's own floor or ground, never a gradient scrim) so the bar reads. When the page already has a fixed bottom bar, that bar swaps its controls for these as the stage enters (the old ones slide up 12px and out, the new ones slide in, 180ms); otherwise the bar is simply the last 64px of the stage. Phone: Stage 100svh; headline 32px; the bar becomes two lines (legal above, links below) with 16px padding.
phone: Stage 100svh; headline 32px; the bar becomes two lines (legal above, links below) with 16px padding.
houseRuleCheck: Social and contact appear as text links; the bar has no rail, progress indicator, glass or scrim, and the stage is dark under it. The legal line keeps the footer working. No conflict.

name: Giant call left, link grid right
description: Footer split in halves, 64px side padding, 120px top padding, content in the top 0.7 screen and calm empty ground below to a full 100vh. Left half (x 64-700): a three-line call to action at 96px in the display face (one style) and, 48px under it, a filled pill button 56px tall. Right half (from x 780): a one-sentence intro at 20px, then 64px lower a 2x2 grid of link groups (social, pages, location, email), each an 18px medium title over 16px links 8px apart, 64px column gap, 56px row gap. A 14px legal line sits at the bottom left. Flat tint ground (pale or dark), high-contrast ink, the accent only on the button. On enter the headline lines clip-rise and the groups fade-rise 80ms apart. Phone: Headline 48px, the grid stays 2 columns, the button full width.
phone: Headline 48px, the grid stays 2 columns, the button full width.
houseRuleCheck: The email stays a normal link, never set giant. The headline is one style with no accent word.

name: Giant word left with pill
description: A closing canvas screen (100vh) on a flat deep ground. One giant word at 20vw (about 290px at 1440) is set left-aligned at the left margin (64px), vertically centred a little low, in the display face, ink off-white or near-black. The word is a verb or short invitation, never the brand name, and has one style. 40px beneath it a filled pill button (56px, accent) sits at the left and a small plain toggle (sound or theme) at the far right, on the 64px margin. No link columns: a 14px row along the bottom carries the legal line and two contact links. The word reveals by a clip-rise on enter while the last scene stays behind it as a still frame. Phone: Word 22vw on one or two lines; the pill full width; the toggle above it.
phone: Word 22vw on one or two lines; the pill full width; the toggle above it.
houseRuleCheck: The giant word is a verb or an invitation, never the brand name, so it is not the giant footer name. The bottom row keeps the footer working without link columns.

name: Headline, links, newsletter row
description: A dark block that slides up over the previous scene, about 0.9 screen (800px at 1440), 64px side padding, 120px top padding. Row one: at the left a two-line headline at 44px (max 560px) with a filled secondary pill under it (a lighter tone of the ground, ink text, no border); at x 760 two link columns on a 233px pitch (18px titles, 16px links); at the far right a small looping video thumbnail 200x120 (radius 16px). 130px lower a newsletter row: a 24px heading at the left, a 48px email field (filled tint, fully rounded) joined to a submit pill in the accent colour. 96px lower a legal row spread across the width at 14px. Rows are separated by space only. Phone: Headline, pill, link columns 2-up, thumbnail full width at 180px, then the field above its button.
phone: Headline, pill, link columns 2-up, thumbnail full width at 180px, then the field above its button.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: A ghost (outlined) pill and a rule would break the outline and hairline bans: the pill is a filled tint and spacing replaces the rule.

name: Headline and render over link columns
description: Dark, one screen, uncovered from under the previous scene (the footer sits fixed behind the end of the main content, which slides up off it). Upper left (x 64, from y 120): a two-word headline set on two lines at 128-144px in the display face (one style, at most 620px wide) with a two-line 24px paragraph (max 460px) 24px beneath it. Upper right: a looping 3D render in a 560px square (a transparent-background video or a WebGL canvas) whose right side sits on the 64px margin, from y 96, never touching the text. Lower left, 80px under the paragraph: three link columns on a 220px pitch from x 64 (18px titles, 16px links), clear of the render. A 14px legal row spreads across the bottom. Pointer movement tilts the render by up to 6 degrees. Phone: Render at 70% width above the headline (56px); columns 2-up; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
phone: Render at 70% width above the headline (56px); columns 2-up; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
houseRuleCheck: A rule above the links breaks the hairline ban and a render clipped by the screen edge breaks the frame rule: the rule is left out and the render stays inside the margin, clear of the headline.

name: Panel with centred render
description: A panel inset 16px from the viewport edges with a 24px radius, one screen (about 880px at 1440), in a tint darker than the page ground. At the top centre a small brand mark (36px high) and a centred two-line statement at 32px (max 520px). A 3D object (a render on a transparent background) rises from the bottom centre, about 620px wide, and is cropped by the panel bottom edge, never the screen edge. A link column sits at the left of it (x 280, five links at 20px on a 44px step, with the legal links at the foot) and a social column at the right (x 1160, four links at 20px). The object follows the pointer by up to 8 degrees and floats 10px. Phone: Statement, then the object at 60% width cropped by the panel bottom, the two columns in a row above it.
phone: Statement, then the object at 60% width cropped by the panel bottom, the two columns in a row above it.
houseRuleCheck: A raised tab at the top centre would read as a drawn shape and is left out. The crop is the panel edge, never the screen edge.

name: Link columns plus newsletter
description: Standard directory with its own signup column, either slim (about 0.3 screen, 260px at 1440) or tall (0.8 screen with calm empty ground under the content). 64px side padding. Three or four link columns on a 200px pitch (20px medium titles, 16px links). The last column, 380px wide, is a filled card in a tint of the ground (radius 20px, 32px padding) holding a two-line 24px heading and a joined email field and button (field 48px tall, button in the accent colour). 96px below, a utility row: copyright at the left, two or three links at the right, 14px; a language selector is a filled pill. Colour roles: solid ground, off-white or near-black ink, accent on the button and link hover only. On hover the link goes to full ink; the card tints one step lighter. Phone: The signup card moves first, full width; the link columns follow 2-up; the utility row stacks.
phone: The signup card moves first, full width; the link columns follow 2-up; the utility row stacks.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: The boxed signup is a filled card, not an outlined box, and the select boxes become filled pills. No conflict left.

name: Link columns with legal tiers
description: Tall directory footer of 0.8 to 1.1 screens (720-980px at 1440) on one solid ground, 64px side padding and 120px top padding, content starting at the left margin. Three to six link columns share the 1312px content width (six on a 200px pitch, three or four on 280-300px). Each column opens with a 20px medium-weight title in full ink, then 16px links on a 36px step in 70% ink; hover turns a link to full ink and grows an accent underline in from the left. Column one can instead be the brand column: the mark at 40-56px high, one short sentence at 18px in 70% ink and a text link, 320px wide, with the link columns starting at x 480. The last column can hold a language or region selector as a filled pill. 96px lower comes a tier of office or contact blocks (three lines each, 16px), then 96px lower the legal row: copyright at the left, policy links at the right, 14px. Tiers are separated by space only. No headline. Colour roles: dark or tinted ground, off-white ink, the accent used only for the hover underline. Phone: Columns become a 2-up grid with 18px titles, the brand column first at full width when used; contact tiers stack in one column with 40px gaps; the legal row stacks and left-aligns.
phone: Columns become a 2-up grid with 18px titles, the brand column first at full width when used; contact tiers stack in one column with 40px gaps; the legal row stacks and left-aligns.
avoidWith: a dense card grid directly above
houseRuleCheck: A rule over the legal row and a strip of social badges would break the hairline and icon bans: tiers are separated by 96px of space and social appears as text links. In the brand-column variant the about text stays one sentence. No conflict left.

name: Link groups over address line
description: White ground, about 0.9 screen (780px at 1440), 64px padding, 12-column grid. Three link groups (menu, social, external) in columns 1-4, 5-8 and 9-12, each with a 20px medium title in ink over its links at 18px on a 38px step, no rules under the titles. About 190px lower the place line (street on one line, city and country on the next, three lines at most) is set in a condensed serif at 48-56px with tight leading in near-black, spanning the grid width. The place is the big line; the phone and email stay 18px links in the groups above. At the bottom, 14px: the legal line at the left and the year at the right. Hover dims the other links of a group to 50%; the place line tints to the accent on hover as a map link. Phone: Groups stack; the place line 32px.
phone: Groups stack; the place line 32px.
houseRuleCheck: Rules under the titles and glyph icons between the words break the hairline and icon bans and are left out. The big line is a place, never the brand name, the email or the phone, and stays at 56px or less.

name: News feed footer
description: Dark ground, about 1.6 screens (1440px at 1440), 64px side padding. The left half (x 64-600) is sticky: a two-line 56px display heading (the signup promise), under it a joined email field and button (48px tall, filled), then social links, small links at 16px and the legal line at 14px, so the left is never empty. The right half (from x 725) holds a feed of three filled cards (radius 20px, 16px gaps, one tint lighter than the ground): each with a 224px square thumbnail at the left, a status chip and a date in sentence case at 16px, a 24px title and two lines of 16px text; then two text-only event cards in the same fill. No dividing rules. Hover lifts the card tint one step and scales the thumbnail to 1.04; cards fade-rise on enter, 80ms apart. Phone: The sticky block becomes the top block; cards stack with a 96px thumbnail at the left of each.
phone: The sticky block becomes the top block; cards stack with a 96px thumbnail at the left of each.
avoidWith: a news or journal section on the same page
a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Hairline-divided rows and an almost empty left half would break the rule and empty-left bans: filled cards and a sticky left block fix both. Keep the text to two lines per card, and never repeat a feed the page already shows.

name: Panel lifts over colour floor
description: A two-layer curtain footer. Layer one is a pale panel (radius 12px, inset 24px from the viewport edges, about 450px tall, 56px padding) holding a one-line brand sentence at 24px at the left and three link columns on a 160px pitch (16px links), with a copyright row at 14px below. As the panel scrolls up it uncovers a fixed full-bleed floor in the accent colour behind it (100vh). On the floor sit a centred line at 32px in the display face; a row of three filled chips (44px tall pills in a darker tint of the floor, 16px text) that each show a live value in words: local time, open or closed now, or the current season, refreshed every minute; and a small centred mark 50px above the bottom. Floor ink is whichever of off-white or near-black contrasts with the accent. The lift is the only motion. Phone: Panel inset 12px with the columns 2-up; floor line 24px; chips wrap into centred pills; the floor stays fixed at 100svh.
phone: Panel inset 12px with the columns 2-up; floor line 24px; chips wrap into centred pills; the floor stays fixed at 100svh.
houseRuleCheck: Chips are filled, never outlined, and show words or a time, never a counter. The panel is one card over a floor, not boxes in boxes. No other conflict.

name: Particle canvas, staggered statements
description: A dark canvas about 1.1 screens (1000px at 1440) with drifting particles in one tint (solid round dots of 2-4px, no connecting lines, they drift upward and away from the pointer). Two statements form a diagonal reading line: the first at mid-page left (x 64-720) at 44px in sentence case, the second 90px lower, right-aligned (ending at x 1376) at 44px, with a filled accent pill (56px tall) at its right end. Low in the footer a filled email field (pill, 48px tall, 420px wide) sits at the left with a 16px hint above it, and at the right a 14px row with the legal line, a one-line credit and two contact links. Each statement reveals line by line as it crosses 60% of the viewport. Off-white ink on the dark ground. Phone: Statements stack left-aligned at 28px; the field is full width.
phone: Statements stack left-aligned at 28px; the field is full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: An underlined field and a dashed credit box would break the hairline and outline bans: the field is a filled pill and the credit a plain line. Particles are small solid dots in one tint, an ambient field, not a drawn illustration.

name: Photo band over directory row
description: About 1.1 screens (1000px at 1440). A treated photo (art-directed, one hue, never documentary) fills the top 58% (580px) inside 24px margins with radius 24px, under a uniform dark tint at 30% for legibility. At its upper left (48px in) a two-line statement at 64px in off-white, and under it a wide pill button (accent fill, 72px tall, 360px wide); the button is the only element on the photo. The bottom row sits on the page ground with 64px padding: the logo lockup (36px) at the left; three link groups on a 220px pitch and a filled signup card (radius 20px, 360px wide) at the right; 64px under it a 14px legal row. The photo drifts 8% slower than the scroll. Phone: The photo is 420px high with the statement at 36px; the row stacks.
phone: The photo is 420px high with the statement at 36px; the row stacks.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: A large wordmark on the photo would be the giant footer name: a statement replaces it. Only the statement and one button sit on the photo, never a card. The photo is art-directed, never documentary.

name: Colophon with photo
description: White ground, an 8-column grid with 36px margins, about 420px tall with 96px vertical padding. Columns 1-2: a 209x279 portrait photo (radius 12px) with a two-line 16px caption under it. Columns 5-6 and 7-8: two 315px text columns at 17px on 1.5 leading. The first holds a 20px heading and one short paragraph with an inline link underlined in the accent; the second holds three label-value contact groups, the label a 16px medium word (for example studio) over the value at 17px, 24px apart, then the legal line at 14px. Each line rises 26px and fades in as it enters, 30ms apart. Phone: Single column: photo at 60% width, then the two text blocks.
phone: Single column: photo at 60% width, then the two text blocks.
houseRuleCheck: Bracket characters around the heading are left out and the labels are sentence-case words, not tiny uppercase. Keep to one short paragraph. The photo is crafted, never an archive shot.

name: Physics pile of link tiles
description: A full-screen (100vh) footer on a flat dark ground holding a physics pile of about 16 rounded tiles (pills and rounded rectangles, 64-96px tall, radius 24px, in three palette tones plus the accent). Each tile carries one lowercase word in the display face at 24px (page names, values or verbs); the tiles that are page links are the ones in the accent fill. They drop in from above as the footer enters and settle at the bottom with gravity, restitution 0.3 and a random angle up to 20 degrees; the pointer can push them and a click on a link tile navigates. At the bottom left a row of social text links at 16px; at the bottom right the legal line at 14px. Needs a small physics engine (about 30kB). Phone: Ten tiles, 56px tall; the links row above the pile. Reduced motion: tiles shown already settled.
phone: Ten tiles, 56px tall; the links row above the pile. Reduced motion: tiles shown already settled.
avoidWith: another physics scene on the page
houseRuleCheck: Wordmark tiles on shield shapes would be the giant name and drawn shapes: the tiles are plain rounded word pills that double as the sitemap. Three tones plus the accent at most, to avoid colour sprawl.

name: Two big-type info cards
description: About 0.5 screen (450px at 1440), 64px side padding. Two equal cards sharing the 1312px content width (648px each, 16px gap, radius 24px), each with its own fill: one in the accent tone, one in a darker tint of the ground; 40px padding. In each card a 32px medium heading (for example visit, write), and 48px under it a three-line address or contact block at 28px in 70% ink (the h3 step; an email gets a copy button beside it). Under the two cards a 14px legal row. No rules or lines. Hover steps a card fill one tone and underlines the contact line in ink. Phone: Cards stack, text 24px.
phone: Cards stack, text 24px.
houseRuleCheck: A full-height vertical rule and horizontal rules break the hairline ban: two filled cards replace them. The contact lines stay at the h3 step, never giant, three lines at most.

name: Scattered cut-outs over signup
description: A saturated colour ground with a straight top edge and 40px rounded corners, about 1.15 screens (1035px at 1440). Six cut-out objects (raster images with transparent backgrounds, photographed or rendered objects of 150-375px, each rotated between -18 and +18 degrees) are scattered over the top two thirds and stay inside the 40px margins. They sway 6px on slow loops and one hops toward the pointer on hover. Below them a centred one-line headline at 48px (one style, near-black or white) and 40px under it a white email pill (a 64px tall field joined to a submit button in the page ink with ground-colour text). A row of four text links at 18px and the 14px legal line closes the bottom with 64px padding. Phone: Four objects of 120-200px; the headline on two lines; the field full width.
phone: Four objects of 120-200px; the headline on two lines; the field full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Drawn illustrated shapes and a wavy top edge break the drawn-shape ban: photographed or rendered cut-outs and a straight rounded top replace them. Needs real object imagery; if only drawn art exists, do not deal this.

name: Single-baseline closing line
description: A bare footer screen 80vh tall after the page's normal section space, so the footer reads as a long breath at the end without ever holding half a screen of nothing. One row on a shared baseline at about 40% of the footer height: at the left (64px margin) a small cluster of two text links at 16px, then a 32px serif lead-in phrase, and at the right an 86px serif phrase that finishes the sentence and ends exactly at the right margin (64px, margins mirrored). Neither phrase is the brand name or a person name. Along the bottom edge at 14px: a replay link and the legal line at the left, a one-line centred credit, and a sound toggle (only if the page has audio) at the right. The big phrase fades in letter by letter on enter. Phone: The two phrases stack on two baselines, left-aligned, 28px and 56px.
phone: The two phrases stack on two baselines, left-aligned, 28px and 56px.
houseRuleCheck: Two names at 86px would be the giant name ban: one closing sentence is split across two sizes instead. The credit is one line, never a wall. The pause before the row stays under half a screen, counting the section space above.

name: Single masked image
description: One screen (100vh) of flat colour with nothing but one picture cropped into a square rotated 45 degrees (a diamond about 444px across), centred horizontally and starting 120px from the top. The picture is art-directed or a rendered object, and the ground is a saturated colour that the picture palette picks up. Nothing else stands on the screen but one centred 14px row 32px from the bottom (the legal line and two contact links), so the page ends in a pause and still works. On scroll the diamond turns between -5 and 5 degrees and the picture inside shifts 12% in parallax. Phone: Diamond at 70% of the width; the same pause.
phone: Diamond at 70% of the width; the same pause.
houseRuleCheck: A diamond crop is a picture mask, not a drawn shape. The bottom row keeps legal and contact links; if the page needs a full sitemap, deal another pattern.

name: Sparse screen, logo and tagline
description: A nearly empty white screen (100vh). One 40px link with a corner arrow sits on the centre line (x 720) a third of the way down (y 300), so no more than half a screen stands empty. In the lower band, ending 164px above the bottom, the brand logo (300-360px wide as supplied, or the name set in the display face at 48px) stands at the left margin (64px) and a two-line tagline at 40px starts at the centre line (x 720). A 14px row 40px from the bottom carries the legal line and two contact links. Everything else is empty ground. Near-black ink; the accent only on the link arrow. Hover moves the arrow 8px diagonally. Phone: Link, then logo, then tagline, stacked with 64px gaps; 100svh.
phone: Link, then logo, then tagline, stacked with 64px gaps; 100svh.
houseRuleCheck: A logo built of horizontal bars would be a drawn shape: use the supplied mark or plain type, under 40% of the width, so it is not a giant name.

name: Statement over three word links
description: Full-screen (100vh) black with the content pushed to the bottom (64px bottom padding). A three-line statement at 100px in a heavy display face (upper case allowed), centred in a 720px measure, one style. 80px under it a row of three word links at 50px sharing one baseline: one at the left margin, one centred, one ending at the right margin. Then a three-thirds legal row at 14px (copyright left, one link centre, one link right) and a one-line credit. Hover slides the hovered word 8px up and tints it with the accent while the others dim to 50%; a click does a 300ms colour wipe from the word. Phone: Statement 48px; the three words stacked at 40px, centred.
phone: Statement 48px; the three words stacked at 40px, centred.
houseRuleCheck: Keep the credit to one line. The statement is one style with no accent word. No other conflict.

name: Wide info column, joined email
description: Dark, about 0.55 screen (500px at 1440), 24px side margins. A wide first column (x 24-700): a 130x100 picture (radius 12px) at the left beside a three-line text block at 18px; 24px under it a one-line credit at 14px and a text link; at the foot of the column a 113px-wide logo over the copyright at 14px. Two narrow link columns at the right (x 740 and 1090; 18px titles, 16px links on a 36px step). Under them a joined email field and button 587x44 across both columns (field in a lighter tint, button in the accent). Hover grows a link underline in from the left. Phone: The picture-and-text row first, the link columns 2-up, the joined field full width.
phone: The picture-and-text row first, the link columns 2-up, the joined field full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: The credit stays one line, never a wall of sponsor logos. No other conflict.
